title: The Effect of Human v/s Synthetic Test Data and Round-tripping on Assessment of Sentiment Analysis Systems for Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating sentiment analysis systems by computing Weighted Rejection Score (WRS) and Deconfounding Impact Estimate (DIE) via causal models. This is applied to synthetic datasets with gender variations and human-generated chatbot datasets appended with gender proxy terms ('Hey boy', 'Hey girl'), as well as measuring the impact of round-trip translation on these scores.

Evaluating sentiment analysis systems by computing Weighted Rejection Score (WRS) and Deconfounding Impact Estimate (DIE) via causal models on synthetic text templates (from the EEC dataset) that substitute proper names associated with different races (European vs. African-American).
